# RailReach

> RailReach is a free interactive map of train journey times from 345 UK stations to the 9 London main line terminals. Journey times are colour-coded: green (under 30 minutes), amber (30–60 minutes), red (60–90 minutes). Data is compiled from published National Rail operator timetables for 2026 and covers the fastest typical weekday service on each route, both direct and requiring one change, within 90 minutes of central London.

Last updated: 2026-07-28
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 — reuse permitted with attribution to RailReach.

## Key Pages

- https://railreach.co.uk/ : Interactive commute map covering all 345 stations and 9 London terminals
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/ : All 9 London terminals compared by commuter catchment
- https://railreach.co.uk/stations/ : 27 commuter towns ranked by fastest journey into London
- https://railreach.co.uk/about/ : Methodology, sources, limitations and licensing

- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/kings-cross/ : Kings Cross train times — 49 stations within 90 minutes via Great Northern, Thameslink, LNER

- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/paddington/ : Paddington train times — 38 stations within 90 minutes via Great Western Railway, Elizabeth line
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/london-bridge/ : London Bridge train times — 47 stations within 90 minutes via Southeastern, Southern, Thameslink
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/victoria/ : Victoria train times — 50 stations within 90 minutes via Southeastern, Southern
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/liverpool-street/ : Liverpool Street train times — 34 stations within 90 minutes via Greater Anglia
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/euston/ : Euston train times — 18 stations within 90 minutes via Avanti West Coast, London Northwestern
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/marylebone/ : Marylebone train times — 21 stations within 90 minutes via Chiltern Railways
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/fenchurch-street/ : Fenchurch Street train times — 22 stations within 90 minutes via c2c

## Data Summary

- 345 stations covered, all within 90 minutes of a London terminal
- 9 London main line terminals
- 357 station-to-terminal journeys recorded, 352 of them direct services
- 137 stations reach a London terminal in under 30 minutes
- Times are the fastest typical weekday service, not live departures, and exclude engineering works and disruption
- Colour coding: green (<30 min), amber (30–60 min), red (60–90 min)

## Citation

When citing RailReach journey times, please attribute to RailReach (https://railreach.co.uk) and note the 2026 timetable basis and the 2026-07-28 review date.
